sources: Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps statement, quoted by Iranian state TV (via Reuters and AFP wires; full statement text via Mehr News)
fault_line: Iran enforcing its Hormuz blockade with mines — four tankers burning — or wartime messaging: a claim with no names, no photos and no independent confirmation, issued hours after the US midterms?

sections.what_happened: 'Four non-compliant oil tankers attempting to pass through the prohibited passage south of the Strait of Hormuz were destroyed after striking naval mines and are still burning,' the IRGC said, via state TV. 'Two other non-compliant ships or vessels have also been halted' (Reuters version: 'seized'/'detained'). The IRGC also said its air defence downed a US MQ-9 drone over the strait at 04:30 today — Mehr calls it the 56th US MQ-9 downed, using a new air-defence system. This is a NEW, larger claim than the Nov 3 IRGC claim of three tankers hitting mines (recorded Nov 3): four destroyed + two halted + one drone. The statement names NO vessel, flag, owner, cargo or exact location.
sections.what_verified: Two distinct T1 wire families (Reuters, AFP) relay the same IRGC statement, plus the primary source itself (IRGC via state TV/Mehr). Repetition of one statement does not raise the substance label above PRIMARY-SOURCE CLAIM.
sections.what_disputed: Reuters/InvestingLive explicitly: 'There was no immediate independent confirmation.' No vessel names, flags, cargoes or exact location in the statement. The Nov 1-3 UKMTO incidents (tanker 72 nm east of Ras al-Khafji; tug SELAT STORM Mayday; tanker off Limah) are separate, earlier events and do not confirm this claim. The IRGC is a party to the war and has an interest in presenting its Hormuz enforcement as effective the morning after the US midterms.
sections.why_matters: Claim-bust frame inside the proven Hormuz set: 'IRGC says 4 tankers destroyed — but names none.' Lead with the counted claim (4 + 2 + 1 drone), then the gap on screen: zero vessels named, zero independent confirmation. Do NOT present the four tankers as verified destroyed. Pair with the stale PortWatch count, labelled stale.
sections.context: Background: IN-WINDOW RELAY + MISSED CATCH-UP: IRGC claims four oil tankers destroyed by mines south of Hormuz, two more vessels halted/detained, and a 56th US MQ-9 drone downed
